أختلج (form VIII)
# أَخْتَلِجُ (ʔaḵtaliju) /ʔax.ta.li.d͡ʒu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
# أَخْتَلِجَ (ʔaḵtalija) /ʔax.ta.li.d͡ʒa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
# أَخْتَلِجْ (ʔaḵtalij) /ʔax.ta.lid͡ʒ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
